what: Retained-set seeding lacks explicit dedupe when filling to eight
scenario_or_breakage: Seeding ACTUAL_VERSION then walking the sorted list without skipping versions already in the set can retain nine cache dirs when the target is already in the top eight
suggested_fix: Specify skip-if-already-retained while filling to KEEP_VERSIONS=8; add a harness case that asserts exactly eight dirs remain when ACTUAL_VERSION is already among the newest eight
